entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production PIXEL ART battle sprite sheet for THIEF, based on the supplied original references. Reference 1 is the exact four-person thief COSTUME and identity: dark green short hooded cloaks, brown leather tunics, belts and pouches, brown trousers and boots, compact single daggers. Only the fourth woman has her hood up, with her long violet hair visible; preserve the other three uncovered hairstyles. Reference 2 is the approved face/hair/body design, NOT its clothing. Reference 3 is the approved completed battle sheet: match its apparent body proportions, pixel-art detail, full-body size and left-facing three-quarter camera, NOT its warrior clothing, sword or shield. Exactly FOUR ROWS by THREE COLUMNS, twelve separate full-body sprites. Row 1 Kaina, young blue-black spiky-haired man with amber/brown eyes; row 2 Rione, auburn high-ponytail woman with green eyes; row 3 Haldo, silver tousled-haired man with brown eyes; row 4 Suina, long violet-haired woman with violet eyes. Keep each person's face, hairstyle and build invariant across the three columns and faithful to references. ALL face LEFT, slight three-quarter view. Columns 1 idle ready holding dagger close to body; 2 compact distinct forward dagger thrust; 3 distinct hurt recoil, eyes shut/pained, dagger retained. Consistent feet ground line and body scale in each row; attacks and recoil may bend the knees but must not become smaller people. Generous transparent gutters and 20% padding around each sprite; no touching, clipping or stray pixels, no detached effects, no floor, no shadows, no labels, no text or grid. Actual transparent background. Tall portrait canvas approximately 1536x2048. Intended for separate 96x96 frames then nearest-neighbor display at 72px. Crisp controlled natural-colored pixel clusters matching the approved battle artwork, not smooth painting. Only the requested job wardrobe; no redesign, added accessories or commercial-game content.
